reviews.reason: Not safe as supplied: the scans read ወእተ, ወድንጋፄከ, and ገጸ rather than ውእተ, ወድንጋጼከ, and ገጹ. Both source asterisks and the final ፡፡ are correctly retained. The English and both notes are substantively sound. Page 55 note 46 and page 56 note 4 establish Charles’s editorial restoration of the answer verb after Uriel’s question, not agreement of all Ethiopic manuscripts on that placement.
reviews.suggested_text: At that time Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and alarmed?” And I answered[a], “Because of this terrifying place and the sight of this suffering[b].”
reviews.footnote_changes: In note a, correct ወድንጋጼከ to ወድንጋፄከ. Retain its explicit distinction between editorial restoration and manuscript attestation. Retain note b.
